To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(a) it is possible, in urban settings, to predict contact times with access points, and (b) such predictions are useful for players who wish to play mobile online games.

1) it is feasible to predict the contact time in an urban setting, 2) the contact time can be predicted accurately enough to provide valuable information about what tasks can be accomplished during the connectivity period, 3) the contact time is highly dependent upon the speed of the vehicle, and 4) the contact time depends on the time of the day.
we propose a novel solution for estimating the duration of a WiFi connection in vehicular scenarios, which is validated by means of simulation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
satisfying the hunger for mobile games and, in doing so, providing quality time in vehi- cular scenarios.

the problem of estimating the contact time of a moving player with an AP, and providing a mechanism that is able to suggest to a player what tasks he can accomplish while moving, in terms of online games.
the design of mechanisms to improve the user experience when playing online games while traveling in a car.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

our mechanism can be used to estimate the time of contact with a set of WiFi access points and provide a valuable indication to the user regarding what he/she will (not) be able to achieve, while moving in the car.

the proposed mechanism is able to provide a valuable advice to the player regarding which tasks he/she will presumably be able to perform, in terms of online gaming, during the available WiFi connectivity time.
the proposed approach provides valuable support to a player who wishes to enjoy a mobile gaming experience while moving in an urban setting.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
of providing a mechanism that is capable of providing valuable advice to a user in terms of which tasks it will be able to accomplish while moving, in a car, in a city.
of showing the possibility to provide a quality time to a mobile gamer while in a car, by means of a simple and efficient mechanism.
of providing a mechanism capable of satisfying the hunger for mobile, high interactivity online games.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quality of the online game experience can be improved, even when moving on the streets of an urban setting.

the proposed mechanism is capable of providing a player with an estimation of the time he/she will be connected in a given scenario, thus enabling him/her to make informed decisions on what to do with the available time.
